name: 08210 · Cape May Ch, NJ
findings: ZIP 08210 (Cape May Ch) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08210 (Cape May Ch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08210 (Cape May Ch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
